meta.name: aeon
meta.description: This skill should be used for time series machine learning tasks including classification, regression, clustering, forecasting, anomaly detection, segmentation, and similarity search. Use when working with temporal data, sequential patterns, or time-indexed observations requiring specialized algorithms beyond standard ML approaches. Particularly suited for univariate and multivariate time series analysis with scikit-learn compatible APIs.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 完成时间序列数据的分类、预测与异常识别
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手头有按时间顺序记录的数据,想预测走向或发现问题
copy.tagline_en: Build forecasting, classification and anomaly detection models on time-stamped data.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have time-stamped data and want to forecast trends or spot unusual patterns.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用 aeon 这个 Python 库写时间序列机器学习代码,覆盖分类、回归、聚类、预测、异常检测等任务,输出可直接运行的脚本、算法选择建议和绘图代码。
howto.when: 当你处理时间序列或带时间索引的数据,或需要分类、异常检测等超出常规机器学习的算法时会触发。

say.text: 帮我用 STOMP 检测这段序列里的异常点,并画出异常分数曲线
say.note: 会返回异常分数和 95% 阈值以上的点

say.text: 用 DTW 距离的 KNN 分类器训练我的多变量时间序列
say.note: 会用弹性距离构建 scikit-learn 风格分类器

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude writes Python code with the aeon toolkit for time series machine learning, covering classification, regression, clustering, forecasting and anomaly detection, using scikit-learn compatible estimator APIs.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you work with temporal or time-indexed data, or need specialized algorithms such as classification or anomaly detection beyond standard ML approaches.

say_en.text: Use aeon's RocketClassifier on the GunPoint dataset and report the accuracy
say_en.note: Loads data, fits the model and scores it

say_en.text: Detect anomalies in my series with STOMP and plot the anomaly scores
say_en.note: Returns scores and points above the 95% threshold

say_en.text: Train a KNN classifier with DTW distance on my multivariate time series
